title: What do you do when an estimate goes unanswered?
text: Genuine question — I've been talking to a lot of shops lately. You send the quote, hear nothing back. Do you follow up? How many times, and how — call, text, email? Or just move on to the next job? Trying to understand what actually works vs. what everyone means to do but doesn't. What's your process?
triage_reason: Contractor dealing with a recurring workflow gap of unanswered estimates.
